title: A residual stress linear through a beam's depth, released
source: Timoshenko and Goodier, Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed., McGraw-Hill 1970, §150 (a thermal strain linear in the coordinates is compatible and leaves a free body stress-free): the beam held at its ends (u_x = 0) while its thermal strain α (T − T₀(z)) is linear in z carries σ_xx = −E α (T − T₀(z)) and nothing else; mapped as the initial stress σ₀ of a free beam, it is released entirely into the strain −C⁻¹σ₀, linear in z, so the beam is left stress-free with the curvature 2 s/(E H) of a stress s (2z/H − 1) about its mean
